decision: rejected; SVG template prototype not shipped; exact published/installed runtime restored

separateCallDiagnostic.scope: Instrumented calls include the initial graph and normal selection path. Call wrappers are absent in the latency/CPU comparison. This is not a timing result.

prototype.behavior: At most 16 detached shallow SVG templates per complete render, clone attributes and reset changed values; clear on full replacement.

interpretation: Fewer JS-to-Native attribute calls did not establish lower CPU. SVG DOM allocation count remains similar, with cloning/key construction added. At 1200 and 5000 rows all four adjacent browser-CPU pairs increased in this run. Paired total latency is mixed; retain all samples and reject the prototype. No claim about cloning on every machine, actual VS Code CPU, overall RAM or full interaction/visual QA of the prototype.

verification.diagnosticChanges: Opt-in SVG Native-call counters and after-measurement SVG hash, no product runtime flags.
verification.nativeClickAndDataChecks: Native independent log, local branch data, protected metadata and normal HEAD selection checked in all owned documents.
